## ADB Disabler

[简体中文](README_ZH.md)

- Works on Magisk / KernelSU / APatch
- Disables Developer options, USB debugging and OEM unlocking at boot

## Install

Download `ADB-Disabler-1.0.1.zip`, flash it in your manager, reboot.

| Manager | Version |
|---|---|
| Magisk | 20.4+ |
| KernelSU | 0.9.0+ |
| APatch | 10.7+ |

## Build

```sh
python3 build.py
```
